I'm testing a rule where each colored marker fills rows downward from just after the previous marker's position up through its own row, checking this against example columns with a 5 marker at the bottom.

Confirming this pattern holds across multiple columns and examples (col8, col4, col5 in different examples), where each cell takes the color of the nearest marker at or below it, with ties resolving to the later occurrence. Now I'm ready to apply this rule to the test input.

I'm tracing which columns have a 5 at row16, then working out how the color markers fill each column segment by segment, using each marker's row to determine the range it colors down to the next marker.
